gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all notification schemes to understand how notifications are configured across different projects.
gold.ideal: The response should return a list of all notification schemes with their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new notification scheme to customize notifications for a new project.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the notification scheme and return its ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to see which notification schemes are mapped to my projects to ensure I receive the right alerts.
gold.ideal: The response should list all projects along with their associated notification schemes.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to view the details of a specific notification scheme to verify its settings.
gold.ideal: The response should provide the details of the specified notification scheme, including its name and notifications.

gold.user: As a project owner, I want to update an existing notification scheme to add new notification types.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the updated notification scheme details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to add notifications to a notification scheme to ensure all relevant users are alerted.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the addition of notifications and list the updated notifications in the scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to delete an obsolete notification scheme to clean up the system.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the notification scheme.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to remove a specific notification from a scheme to reduce unnecessary alerts.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the removal of the notification from the scheme.
